entity: Official US federal place names containing "Negro" (USGS/BGN names file)
what_we_add: 438 names (426 current, 12 historical); 105 list the n-word as an older name; 641 "Squaw" renamings vs at least 41 "Negro"/n-word ones in 2020-23
why: Atmos (2022) counts 469 features still carrying the replacement word in the USGS names database: 7% off our 438, same direction; the quote says 'the replacement word', not 'Negro', which the lead's own n-word note supports. No source compares the Squaw vs Negro renaming pace; CRS and Interior's 650-657 Squaw count agrees with our 641.
